cpt.prepared: e.g. Finished the CPT module, offer letter, OGS checklist
cpt.submitted: e.g. Uploaded the CPT form and offer letter to the OGS portal
cpt.resultReceived: e.g. Got the new I-20 PDF by school email
cpt.nextStep: e.g. Print and sign the I-20, line up the start date

opt.prepared: e.g. OGS OPT workshop, I-765, passport photos, proof of graduation
opt.submitted: e.g. Filed the I-765 online with USCIS after OGS recommendation, paid the fee
opt.resultReceived: e.g. EAD card arrived by mail, approval showed in my account
opt.nextStep: e.g. Put the EAD expiration and STEM extension requirements on my calendar

stem-opt.prepared: e.g. I-983, company info, contacted OGS/DSO
stem-opt.submitted: e.g. Filed the STEM OPT extension after OGS review
stem-opt.resultReceived: e.g. Got the I-797 approval notice by email/mail

visa.prepared: e.g. DS-160, financial documents, practiced interview questions
visa.submitted: e.g. Booked the embassy interview and submitted documents
visa.resultReceived: e.g. Visa approved, got my passport back
visa.nextStep: e.g. Enter the US, check I-94, register with SEVIS/school

green-card.prepared: e.g. I-140/I-485 paperwork, medical exam, lawyer meeting
green-card.submitted: e.g. Filed the USCIS petition online/by mail, attended the interview
green-card.resultReceived: e.g. Approval notice, then the green card arrived by mail
green-card.nextStep: e.g. Confirm the card, check re-entry and renewal dates
